baseline_trigger: A complete new Fall Enrollment and directory package is available under the documented collection structure.
methodology_escalation: A revised file hash, variable/code change, release-status change, dictionary change, or universe-definition change affects comparability.
research_question_escalation: A same-method release confirms or reverses a material finding such as the undergraduate-led latest-year shift or state recovery pattern.
affected_surface: Annual IPEDS analysis; QA queue; state profiles; research memo
review_boundary: Package availability starts schema review; it does not authorize publication.

baseline_trigger: NCES changes the public release sequence or timing information.
methodology_escalation: A timing change alters the meaning of the data year, provisional/final status, or when a component can be compared across vintages.
research_question_escalation: A newly available component or earlier indicator creates a defensible monitoring question not covered by the current annual product.
affected_surface: Freshness monitor; data calendar; update playbook
review_boundary: A schedule change is an operational signal, not an analytical result.

baseline_trigger: NCES changes the documented collection cycle, reference period, or reporting-period timing.
methodology_escalation: Any timing change affects the interpretation of a year, reference date, or cross-year comparability.
research_question_escalation: A changed collection/reference period creates a new comparability question that cannot be resolved by a routine rebuild.
affected_surface: Methodology; variable mapping; annual update interpretation
review_boundary: Interpretation must be resolved before new values enter narrative use.

baseline_trigger: NCES changes the federal reporting definition or terminology used for U.S. nonresident or related categories.
methodology_escalation: Any change to inclusion/exclusion rules, citizenship/status terminology, or reporting categories affects the population boundary.
research_question_escalation: A revised federal category creates or closes a research question about comparability with immigrant-origin, undocumented, or international populations.
review_boundary: Definition changes require a crosswalk review before trend arithmetic continues.

baseline_trigger: A newer Digest Table 306.10 is published with the same benchmark universe and comparable rows.
methodology_escalation: The benchmark universe, table definition, release status, or subgroup treatment changes.
research_question_escalation: A same-universe benchmark discrepancy becomes large enough to alter confidence in a published conclusion or expose a source-vintage issue.
affected_surface: Benchmark audit; research memo; validation documentation
review_boundary: The Digest is an external check and never overwrites current IPEDS source values.

baseline_trigger: A new or revised Fall Enrollment archive is released with the expected variables and aggregation structure.
methodology_escalation: Dictionary labels, EFALEVEL codes, imputation/status treatment, file revision, or source schema changes.
research_question_escalation: A same-method annual release materially changes the national/student-level story or creates a new high-priority anomaly pattern.
review_boundary: Source changes enter the schema and QA gates before narrative use.

baseline_trigger: A new or revised institutional directory archive is released with the expected join and universe fields.
methodology_escalation: DEGGRANT, PSET4FLG, CONTROL, geography, UNITID structure, or directory semantics change.
research_question_escalation: A same-method directory update materially changes universe-entry/exit accounting or the distribution of state/control findings.
affected_surface: Analytic universe; state/control joins; institution accounting
review_boundary: Directory availability alone never advances the analysis year.

baseline_trigger: The living national-data surface adds, removes, or materially revises a population, geography, headline estimate, or linked product.
methodology_escalation: The underlying source, denominator, population definition, geography, or methodology changes.
research_question_escalation: New population or state coverage makes a currently held question feasible, or a material same-method conclusion shift warrants a new agenda item.
affected_surface: Research agenda; population crosswalk; companion comparisons
review_boundary: The public Portal surface is contextual evidence, not an input to the IPEDS series.

baseline_trigger: The Portal methodology page changes source definitions, modeling approach, geography, or population coverage.
methodology_escalation: Any methodological change affects a maintained crosswalk row or the comparability of a recurring product.
research_question_escalation: A new method, population, or geography creates a defensible question that existing products do not answer.
affected_surface: Population crosswalk; recurring-product methods; comparison notes
review_boundary: Method changes are reviewed before any recurring-product trend is spliced across vintages.

baseline_trigger: A new recurring report is published using a method-equivalent undocumented higher-education estimate framework.
methodology_escalation: ACS vintage construction, legal-status model, enrollment denominator, geography, or inclusion rules change.
research_question_escalation: A same-method headline shift, new state coverage, or new subgroup output materially changes the access/research questions supported by the product.
affected_surface: Recurring-product register; population trend comparison; research agenda
review_boundary: Same title or publication cadence does not prove method continuity.

baseline_trigger: A new recurring report is published using a method-equivalent CPS immigrant-origin framework.
methodology_escalation: Age range, generation definition, nonimmigrant treatment, CPS construction, geography, or denominator changes.
research_question_escalation: A material same-method shift in enrollment share, growth, or state distribution supports a new or reprioritized research question.
affected_surface: Recurring-product register; population trend comparison; research agenda
review_boundary: A new report is compared only after population and denominator continuity are confirmed.

baseline_trigger: The historical 2019/2021 reference remains unchanged unless the publisher issues a correction or replacement source.
methodology_escalation: A correction, revised methodology note, or changed historical estimate alters the bounded 2019-2021 segment.
research_question_escalation: A corrected historical value materially changes the R04 segmented comparison or interpretation of the historical decline.
affected_surface: Population trend comparison; Research Library provenance
review_boundary: Historical evidence is preserved as a fixed vintage and is not silently replaced by a newer model.

baseline_trigger: A new fact sheet publishes a method-equivalent national undocumented higher-education estimate.
methodology_escalation: ACS/model construction, denominator, geography, or population definition changes.
research_question_escalation: A material same-method change in national scale or newly available geography opens a defensible follow-up question.
affected_surface: Population trend comparison; population crosswalk; research agenda
review_boundary: Current modeled estimates remain separate from IPEDS U.S. nonresident counts.

baseline_trigger: A new recurring high-school-graduate estimate is published under the same pooled-ACS/graduation-rate framework.
methodology_escalation: Pooled ACS period, NCES graduation-rate assumptions, status model, geography, or denominator changes.
research_question_escalation: State/year coverage becomes compatible with undocumented higher-education estimates or a material pipeline shift makes R06 feasible or higher priority.
affected_surface: Recurring-product register; R06 pipeline research; population crosswalk
review_boundary: Do not infer individual transitions from ecological pipeline/enrollment comparisons.

baseline_trigger: New privacy, tuition-equity, or data-minimization guidance changes recommended collection, handling, disclosure, or retention practice.
methodology_escalation: A guidance change also changes population/source definitions or the interpretation of an analytical field.
research_question_escalation: A governance change materially expands or constrains what data can be used for a research question, requiring the question or method to be reframed.
affected_surface: Data governance; public release register; partner-data handling boundary
review_boundary: Do not collect person-level immigration-status data merely because a research question concerns immigrant or undocumented students.
